meta.title: Enquire | Plan a Singapore trip with Five Foot Way
meta.description: Tell us about your Singapore trip or layover. We reply personally by email within two working days.

title: Shall we plan it together?
side: Prefer email? Write to us directly. Please do not send passport numbers or payment details by email or through this form.

faq.q: How much does a trip cost?
a: It depends on your dates, hotels and how much we arrange. We send a written quote with every plan; there is no charge for the first reply.

faq.q: Can you help with just a layover?
a: Yes. Try the [stopover planner](@stopover-planner) first, then write to us if you would like us to arrange a guide, a hotel near the airport or transfers.
For trips in December, around Chinese New Year or during major events, two to three months ahead. For other times, a few weeks is usually enough.
We work by email so that every detail is written down and nothing is lost. We reply within two working days.
